post.caption: Pearl necklace lengths have stage names. Each length has its own name, from collar to rope. A collar is the shortest, snug at the base of the throat, a choker is about 16 inches long, and a princess is about 18 inches, resting just below the collarbone. A matinee is about 20 to 24 inches long, and its name points to daytime shows. An opera is about 28 to 32 inches, at or below the bust, and its name points to evenings at the opera. A rope is longer still, and can be doubled or knotted. Tiffany's own chart runs from 16 inches up to 36.
